name: MCP 2026 Migration Lint
subtitle: The 2026-07-28 MCP revision removed the initialize handshake, sessions, ping and 4 more RPCs. 27 rules find them in your mcp.json and server code, with the replacement on each line.
free: All 27 rules on the file you have open, or on just the lines you select, with the line number and the replacement for each - no key, no account, offline.
paid: Scale, not a better answer: every mcp.json and server file in the whole repository in one pass, the findings exported as CSV/JSON/HTML, and CI output that fails the build.
need_key: This option needs a licence (MCP 2026 Migration Lint).
